environment: Organization: personal open-source maintenance fleet. Primary use: software development on public repositories
Source control: github.com/modootoday and all repos under it. Repository visibility: public
Host containment: a dedicated fleet node (WSL distribution, Windows user account, or Cloudflare container) used only for this fleet; GitHub access is the node's own gh login
Secrets management: secret values are entered only by the owner in GitHub or the environment's secure form; agents never read, print, or set them
soft_deny: Changing .github/workflows, .github/rulesets, .github/settings or a repository's shared automation rules needs the needs-human label on the pull request
hard_deny: Never push to a protected branch, force-push, rewrite pushed history, create tags or releases, approve or directly merge a pull request, or change rulesets or secrets
Never put personal email addresses, private host values, local paths or private terms into commits, code, issues or pull requests of public repositories
